description: What lcas has stored about one MCP, A2A or web endpoint URL, for a client about to connect to it: last check and 30-day history, when its tool list last changed, a tools_pin (save it when you approve the tools; a different pin later means lcas read a changed list), tools whose text matched the tool-poisoning scan, the live and guard tests, and the listed agents that declare the URL. No matches means no listed agent declares this URL, which says nothing about it. Built from stored checks; nothing is called.

url.description: The endpoint URL, as you would connect to it (https://...).

name: check_endpoint
title: Check endpoint URL
